name: service
description: Manage service: create/update/delete/list_containers/update_application/start_application/stop_application/restart_application. A service is a multi-container stack; `list_containers` returns the applications and databases inside it, whose names are what the `logs` tool needs as `container`. Use `update_application` to change a sub-application's FQDN (url) or other settings. Use `start_application`/`stop_application`/`restart_application` to control sub-application lifecycle.

app_uuid.description: Sub-application UUID, required for update_application, start_application, stop_application, restart_application. Get from list_containers.

docker_compose_raw.description: Raw docker-compose YAML for custom services (auto base64-encoded)

url.description: FQDN for the sub-application (update_application only). Comma-separated for multiple.

force_domain_override.description: Force the domain override even if validation fails (update_application only)

latest.description: Pull latest image on start (start_application only)
